name: embabel-me-app
description: Embabel Me sensor app — reads local macOS signals and sends them to your appliance

scripts.postbuild: node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('dist/renderer.js','utf8'); if (/\bexports\b/.test(s)) { console.error('dist/renderer.js references exports — it must compile to a plain script. Remove imports from src/renderer.ts (see src/global.d.ts).'); process.exit(1) }"
scripts.smoke: npm run build && node -e "require('./dist/scanner').scan().then(f => console.log(JSON.stringify(f, null, 2)))"
